title: On weight modules over truncated shifted iYangians
summary: Truncated shifted iYangians are a family of algebras expected to quantize certain components of affine Grassmannian islices. We introduce orientifold KLRW (oKLRW) algebras associated with quivers with involution and establish their faithful polynomial representations and diagrammatic bases. We also define KLR iYangians using double reflective KLR diagrams and construct diagrammatic realizations of the iGKLO homomorphisms.
